lines.translation: Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਲਾਗਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar sahasaa baahar maaiaa nainee laagas baanee ||
lines.translation: There is doubt within me, and Maya is outside; it hits me in the eyes like an arrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਪਰਤਾਪਹਿਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pranavat naanak daasan daasaa parataapahigaa praanee ||4||2||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slaves: such a mortal suffers terribly. ||4||2||
Raamkalee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit dar vasahi kavan dar kaheeai daraa bheetar dar kavan lahai ||
lines.translation: Where is that door, where You live, O Lord? What is that door called? Among all doors, who can find that door?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਫਿਰਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis dar kaaran phiraa udaasee so dar koee aai kahai ||1||
lines.translation: For the sake of that door, I wander around sadly, detached from the world; if only someone would come and tell me about that door. ||1||
How can I cross over the world-ocean?
While I am living, I cannot be dead. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh daravaajaa rohu rakhavaalaa aasaa a(n)desaa dui pat jaRe ||
lines.translation: Pain is the door, and anger is the guard; hope and anxiety are the two shutters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa jal khaaee paanee ghar baadhiaa sat kai aasan purakh rahai ||2||
lines.translation: Maya is the water in the moat; in the middle of this moat, he has built his home. The Primal Lord sits in the Seat of Truth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿੰਤੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ki(n)te naamaa a(n)t na jaaniaa tum sar naahee avar hare ||
lines.translation: You have so many Names, Lord, I do not know their limit. There is no other equal to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: oochaa nahee kahanaa man mahi rahanaa aape jaanai aap kare ||3||
lines.translation: Do not speak out loud - remain in your mind. The Lord Himself knows, and He Himself acts. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab aasaa a(n)desaa tab hee kiu kar ek kahai ||
lines.translation: As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; so how can anyone speak of the One Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa bheetar rahai niraasaa tau naanak ek milai ||4||
lines.translation: In the midst of hope, remain untouched by hope; then, O Nanak, you shall meet the One Lord. ||4||
In this way, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
This is the way to remain dead while yet alive. ||1||Second Pause||3||
Raamkalee, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat sabad saakhee meree si(n)ngee baajai lok sune ||
lines.translation: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pat jholee ma(n)gan kai taaee bheekhiaa naam paRe ||1||
lines.translation: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I receive. ||1||
O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gorakh so jin goi uthaalee karate baar na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee praan pavan ba(n)dh raakhe cha(n)d sooraj mukh deee ||
lines.translation: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and made the lamps of the sun and the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: maran jeevan kau dharatee deenee ete gun visare ||2||
lines.translation: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidh saadhik ar jogee ja(n)gam peer puras bahutere ||
lines.translation: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers and good people.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je tin milaa ta keerat aakhaa taa man sev kare ||3||
lines.translation: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaagad loon rahai ghrit sa(n)ge paanee kamal rahai ||
lines.translation: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remains unaffected in water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: aise bhagat milahi jan naanak tin jam kiaa karai ||4||4||
lines.translation: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4||
Raamkalee, First Mehl:
Listen, Machhindra, to what Nanak says.
One who subdues the five passions does not waver.
One who practices Yoga in such a way,
saves himself, and saves all his generations. ||1||
He alone is a hermit, who attains such understanding.
Day and night, he remains absorbed in deepest Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||
He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.
He is satisfied, with the priceless gift of contentment.
Becoming the embodiment of meditation, he attains the true Yogic posture.
He focuses his consciousness in the deep trance of the True Name. ||2||
Nanak chants the Ambrosial Bani.
Listen, O Machhindra: this is the insignia of the true hermit.
One who, in the midst of hope, remains untouched by hope,
shall truly find the Creator Lord. ||3||
Prays Nanak, I share the mysterious secrets of God.
The Guru and His disciple are joined together!
One who eats this food, this medicine of the Teachings,
